div.div:
شَرِهَ (S, MA, Mgh, Msb, K) عَلَى الطَّعَامِ (MA, Mgh, Msb) وَغَيْرِهِ, (Msb,) or إِلَى الطَّعَامِ, (TA, [perhaps a mistranscription,]) aor.
شَرَهَ , (Msb, K,) inf. n. شَرَهٌ, (S, MA, Mgh, Msb,) said of a man, (S,) He was vehemently desirous, or greedy; (MA;) or very vehemently desirous, or very greedy; (Mgh, Msb;) or overcome by vehement desire, or greediness; (S, K;) of the food (MA, Mgh, Msb) &c.: (Msb:) or, as some say, he was affected with the worst of vehement desire, or of greediness. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
